verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Manchester encoding round-trip — encode 0..0xFFFF on the transmit side, decode on the receive side, verify match.
Manchester encoding error injection — flip a bit-cell mid-bit transition, verify silent discard at the receiver.
Forward-frame framing — 16 information bits + 1 start + 2 stop; verify wrong bit count → silent discard.
Backward-frame framing — 8 information bits + 1 start + 2 stop; verify timing 7..22 TE after end of forward.
Address-byte decode — short (Y=0, AAAAAA=0..63), group (Y=1, AAAAAA[5:2]=group, AAAAAA[1:0]=00), broadcast (Y=1, AAAAAA=111111), special (0xA1..0xCF).
Address-match logic — verify only matching gear act on each forward frame.
B-bit decode — B=0 → direct level (0..254 plus MASK 255); B=1 → indirect command code dispatch.
Direct level boundary — 0 = OFF, 254 = 100%, 255 = MASK (no change).
Logarithmic dimming curve — verify Δ ≈ 2.8% illumination between adjacent levels.
PHYS_MIN_LEVEL clamp — verify Minimum Level cannot be set below the physical floor.
Indirect commands 0x00..0x09 — OFF / UP / DOWN / STEP UP / STEP DOWN / RECALL MAX / RECALL MIN / STEP DOWN AND OFF / ON AND STEP UP / ENABLE DAPC SEQUENCE.
GO TO SCENE 0..15 (0x10..0x1F) — verify Scene lookup + MASK handling.
RESET 0x20 — verify all persistent variables return to defaults (two-strike).
STORE DTR AS ... (0x2A..0x2F, 0x40..0x4F, 0x80, 0xE4) — verify DTR routing into named variable + two-strike commit.
REMOVE FROM SCENE / ADD-REMOVE FROM GROUP — verify scene MASK + group bitmap manipulation.
QUERY STATUS / BALLAST / LAMP FAILURE / LAMP POWER ON / LIMIT ERROR / RESET STATE / MISSING SHORT ADDRESS / VERSION NUMBER / CONTENT DTR / DEVICE TYPE (0x90..0x99) — backward-frame round-trip.
QUERY ACTUAL LEVEL / MIN LEVEL / MAX LEVEL / POWER ON LEVEL / SYSTEM FAILURE LEVEL / FADE TIME-RATE (0xA0..0xA5) — backward values match stored variables.
READ MEMORY LOCATION 0xC5 — bank 0 (mandatory) GTIN / firmware version / hardware version / IEC parts.
STORE DTR AS FAST FADE TIME 0xE4 — verify Fast Fade Time variable.
Special TERMINATE 0xA1 — exit Configuration Mode.
Special DTR 0xA3 — DTR loaded.
Special INITIALIZE 0xA5 — Configuration Mode entry; 15-minute auto-exit.
Special RANDOMIZE 0xA7 — Random Address regenerated.
Special COMPARE 0xA9 — backward 0xFF when Random ≤ Search.
Special WITHDRAW 0xAB — gear drops out when Random == Search.
Special SEARCH ADDRESS H/M/L 0xB1/0xB3/0xB5 — bytewise Search Address loads.
Special PROGRAM SHORT ADDRESS 0xB7 — flash write of new short address.
Special VERIFY SHORT ADDRESS 0xB9 — backward 0xFF on match.
Special QUERY SHORT ADDRESS 0xBB — backward = stored short address.
Special PHYSICAL SELECTION 0xBD — vendor-defined identify-by-touch.
Special ENABLE DEVICE TYPE X 0xC1 — next-frame DT-specific command space.
Special DTR1 / DTR2 0xC3 / 0xC5 — auxiliary DTRs loaded.
Unsupported commands per Table 4 (129, 224..227, 242..251) — verify silent discard.
Unsupported special command WRITE MEMORY LOCATION 0xC7 — verify silent discard.
Inter-frame settle — exactly 22×TE accepted; 21×TE discarded; 13.5 ms recommended floor verified.
Backward-frame window — start at 7..22 TE; outside window verify control-device sees no response.
Two-strike commit — destructive command twice within 100 ms → committed; once → ignored; 101 ms apart → ignored.
Configuration Mode 15-minute auto-exit — INITIALIZE; idle 15 min; verify gear exits.
Power-up Power On Level — bus power-up; no command in 600 ms → Actual Level := Power On Level.
System Failure Level — drop bus voltage; verify Actual Level := System Failure Level.
Flash update — modify persistent variable + trigger TI_DALI_Flash_Update; verify segment erase 4.5 ms + 2.88 ms program + post-reset reload.
WDT+ tick — measure ≈ 1 ms tick (SMCLK/8192 at 8 MHz).
PWM frequency — verify 1.6 kHz with TACCR0 = 5000 at 8 MHz SMCLK (Table 1).
Logarithmic LED table — load LED[0..254] from flash array; index by actual_level; verify Δ ≈ 2.8% step.
MSP430G2xx2 vs MSP430F2131 portability — same DALI core code compiles for both targets via dali_demo_hw.h pinout abstraction (Table 6/7).
Multiple-gear bus arbitration — 64 gear on single bus; sequential addressing + group + broadcast; verify no missed forward frames.
Mixed device-type bus — DT0 + DT6 + DT8 + DT7 gear share bus; ENABLE DEVICE TYPE X selects extended command space.
Bus voltage range 9.5..22.5 V — verify gear operates across the full IEC range (11.5..22.5 V per TI report).
fields.notes: IEC 62386 does not ship a formal Modbus-style conformance testbench in the SLAA422A document; the DALI Alliance (DiiA) administers a separate certification program for DALI-2 conformance. The SLAA422A application report demonstrates a working LED control gear on the TPS62260LED-338 EVM + MSP430F2131 / G2xx2 Launchpad as a reference design but explicitly does not implement bank-1 memory, commands 224..227, queries 242..251, or special command 0xC7 (WRITE MEMORY LOCATION). Verification should cover both the bus-level Manchester / framing layer and the per-command semantic layer for the supported command subsets.
